changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Asset') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[Asset] ( [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [ParentUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [IsGroup] [bit] NOT NULL, [State] [int] NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](4000) NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, [AllocationUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL ) END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.rollback:
if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricsAsset_uid') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Asset] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricsAsset_uid] end
if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricAsset_IsGroup') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Asset] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAsset_IsGroup] end
if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where [type] = 'D' and name = 'DF_MetricAsset_State') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Asset] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAsset_State] end
if exists (select 1 from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS] where constraint_name = 'FK_MetricAsset_Parent') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Asset] DROP CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAsset_Parent] end
if exists (select 1 from [sys].[key_constraints] where name = 'PK_MetricAsset') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Asset] DROP CONSTRAINT PK_MetricAsset WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) end

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql: if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_MetricsAsset') begin CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX [CIX_MetricsAsset] ON [metrics].[Asset] ( [AllocationUid] ASC ) end
changeSet.rollback: if exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_MetricsAsset') begin DROP INDEX [CIX_MetricsAsset] ON [metrics].[Asset] WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) end
